name: wordpress-theme-boilerplate
description: A new WordPress Boilerplate Theme by Ralf Hortt
author: Ralf Hortt <mail@ralfhortt.dev>

scripts.build: npm run generate:theme-types && npm run build:blocks && wp-scripts build src/css/app.scss src/css/editor-styles.scss src/js/app.ts src/js/editor-app.ts --output-path=build/assets && wp-scripts build --source-path=src/blocks/ --blocks-manifest --experimental-modules --output-path=build/blocks && npm run build:theme
scripts.start: npm run generate:theme-types && node bin/build-block-styles.js && concurrently --graceful-exit -n blocks,assets,theme -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run watch:blocks" "npm run watch:assets" "npm run watch:theme"
scripts.watch:assets: node bin/wp-scripts-filter.js start src/css/app.scss src/css/editor-styles.scss src/js/app.ts src/js/editor-app.ts --output-path=build/assets
